obligations.source_text: Create a photorealistic cinematic photograph inside a closed 1970s seaside hotel rehearsal lounge before dawn. A fictional former concert pianist appears as an unmistakably adult woman. Her facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural makeup follow the reference portrait. Her human ghost exists only inside the large tarnished wall mirror. The physical space before the glass is empty, yet the reflection shows her seated at the dusty piano repeating one precise final chord gesture. A framed memorial portrait on the piano shows the same face and hair, establishing her former identity. One depressed piano key and a fresh circular mark in the dust provide a localized consequence. Compose the mirror, empty room, memorial portrait, and changed key in one readable frame with dim coastal window light and credible aged surfaces.

bindings.former_identity_phrase: A memorial portrait establishes the ghost's former identity
bindings.ontological_breach_phrase: The human ghost exists only inside the mirror
bindings.agency_or_consequence_phrase: The ghost repeats one former-life action
bindings.capture_confound_phrase: Scene geometry remains coherent beyond any capture artifact
